title: One carrier. Finished modules. Familiar protocols.
status: Engineering prototype; no physical assembly or RF/power qualification
choice: Preserve functions and Home Assistant compatibility; identical H2 controllers are not required.

functions.name: Thread

functions.test: Network commissioning, recovery and concurrent traffic

functions.name: Zigbee

functions.test: Pairing, backup/restore, antenna switch and flow control

functions.name: Z-Wave
functions.implementation: Existing ZAC93 through WK2132 UART bridge
functions.retained: Regional radio and Z-Wave proxy interface
functions.test: Lossless byte forwarding, errors, resets and full-size frames

functions.name: 433 MHz RF

functions.test: Physical timing, reception and transmit regression

functions.name: Presence
functions.test: Target tracking and all control actions

assembly_steps: Match exact module revisions to the drawings. Program each module before permanent assembly.
Dry-fit the male pins in the plated holes. Check USB access and antenna keepouts.
Fit the listed through-hole parts, then solder module pins from the underside. No female module sockets.
Wire the finished isolated power and UART modules and the existing radios/sensors to the labeled carrier connectors.
Check polarity, continuity and loaded rail voltages before connecting the full assembly.
Commission one function at a time, then test all functions together including power loss and recovery.
manufacturing_claim: One current custom PCB layout; finished vendor modules and external harnesses are still separate physical parts.
unproven: USB/back-power isolation in the real assembly
